title: Senior Specialist, Global Icsr
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Specialist, Global Icsr em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Title: Senior Specialist, Global ICSR Case Processing & QC

Overview:

Seeking an experienced Senior Specialist in Global ICSR Case Processing & QC to independently manage the processing and quality control of individual case safety reports (ICSRs), ensuring regulatory compliance and excellence in data accuracy, completeness, and quality. The role includes SAE reconciliation, meeting compliance and productivity targets, and supporting onboarding and training for new team members.

Key Responsibilities:

  • ICSR Case Processing: Manage case processing and quality control of ICSRs from diverse sources (e.g., clinical trials, post-market, literature) to ensure timely, accurate submissions to regulatory authorities.
  • SAE Reconciliation: Perform SAE reconciliations between safety and clinical databases, track progress, resolve issues, and escalate when necessary.
  • Quality & Compliance: Adhere to KPI and quality metrics, ensuring productivity and process improvement within ICSR management.
  • Decision-Making: Execute decisions in line with operational policies, SOPs, and work instructions.
  • Vendor/CRO Coordination: Ensure ICSR activities align with PV agreements and contracts.
  • Training & Onboarding: Develop and update training materials, onboard new team members, provide feedback, and support the onboarding process.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, clinical medicine, nursing, pharmacy, or equivalent experience; advanced degree preferred.
  • Proficiency with Argus safety database and MS Office Suite.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in drug safety/pharmacovigilance or relevant clinical experience. Preferred 5-8 years of experience
  • Strong understanding of global regulatory requirements (e.g., ICH, FDA, EMA, MHRA) for pharmacovigilance reporting.
  • Excellent communication, problem-solving, time management, and attention to detail.
  • Global cultural awareness and collaborative mindset.

description:

Syniti, part of Capgemini is the enterprise data partner, empowering anyone who relies on data to make business-critical decisions by delivering data they can trust through a unique combination of intelligent software and experts who deeply understand the role of data in enterprise growth. At Syniti, we tackle the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. As the industry’s only pure-play data company, we combine our Data First strategy, intelligent software and team of 100% data-focused experts to turn complex data initiatives into quantifiable business success.

Trusted by the Fortune 2000, Syniti helps leading businesses reconfigure the role of enterprise data from afterthought to foundational first step; enabling them to unlock valuable insights that ignite growth, reduce risk, and expand their competitive advantage. We’ve enabled more than 5,000 successful projects and we’re a trusted partner for global enterprises and organizations throughout their data journeys.

Syniti’s Data First philosophy and enterprise data management platform supports data migration, data quality, data replication, data matching, master data management, analytics, data governance, and data strategy in a single, unified solution.

THE ROLE

The Lab Systems Architect plays a critical role in the success of Syniti’s Education Services department by designing, implementing, and maintaining technical lab environments that support both eLearning and instructor-led training. This role ensures the seamless operation of lab systems, supports integration with learning platforms, and collaborates cross-functionally to enhance system workflows and user experience. The ideal candidate is a technically skilled, detail-oriented problem solver with a passion for enabling learning through robust infrastructure.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Learning Lab Architecture & Management

  • Provide technical oversight for the design, testing, provisioning, and implementation of Learning Lab environments.
  • Manage and maintain lab snapshots, resolving configuration defects as they arise.
  • Optimize lab usage policies in collaboration with Education Coordinators and Leadership.
  • Monitor VM usage reports and metrics, ensuring alignment with budget and demand.
  • Support LMS system integrations as required.
  • Serve as the primary escalation point for lab-related issues and liaise with solution providers to resolve complex problems across all learning lab platforms.

System Administration & Support

  • Allocate and reset user training accounts.
  • Stay current with new feature releases across all education platforms.
  • Provide on-call support for lab systems used in global training programs, including availability during evenings and weekends as needed.
  • Regularly review help desk tickets to identify recurring issues, usage patterns, and knowledge gaps. Recommend targeted training, updated documentation, or additional support resources to proactively address common challenges and improve user experience.
  • Train internal and partner instructors on lab systems.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Management

  • Collaborate with Training Operations, Delivery Management, IT, and Application teams to improve workflows, system functionality, and user experience.
  • Manage stakeholder expectations and requirements related to lab systems and processes.
  • Identify and resolve cross-functional issues to ensure company-wide alignment on lab system needs.

Reporting & Documentation

  • Document system configurations, best practices, and technical procedures.
  • Own and maintain the Education Services Revenue Report, providing monthly updates to Finance.
  • Support the creation and maintenance of Education Services forms, lists, automations, and integrations, as required.

WHAT IT TAKES

  • Proficiency in SQL and at least one of the following databases: Oracle, MS SQL Server, IBM DB2, or MySQL.
  • Experience managing hypervisor solutions and SaaS platform architecture.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Forms, Power Automate, Power BI, and SharePoint.
  • Experience with Windows Server and Azure Active Directory.
  • Understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).

Apoiar a definição de metas, KPIs financeiros e operacionais alinhados às estratégias de cada cliente

Análise de Desempenho e Reporting

  • Elaborar relatórios gerenciais mensais (Management Reports) com análise de variação realizado vs. orçado, drivers de resultado e recomendações de melhoria.
  • Construir e manter dashboards financeiros e painéis de indicadores (KPIs) para acompanhamento contínuo da performance dos clientes.

  • Atuar como business partner de múltiplos clientes simultaneamente, organizando agenda, prazos, entregas e priorizações de forma independente.

  • Apoiar a estruturação de plano de contas gerencial , centros de custo e rateios que reflitam corretamente a operação de cada cliente.

  • Formação superior completa em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Economia, Engenharia, Finanças ou áreas correlatas.
  • Pós-graduação, MBA ou certificações em Finanças, Controladoria, FP&A, CFA, CGMA ou equivalentes.
  • Experiência prática com construção de orçamento, forecast, DRE gerencial e fluxo de caixa projetado .
  • Domínio avançado de Excel (modelagem financeira, fórmulas complexas, tabelas dinâmicas, Power Query).
  • Vivência em gestão simultânea de múltiplas empresas, clientes ou unidades de negócio — experiência em BPO Financeiro, consultoria, family office, holding ou auditoria é altamente desejável.
  • Capacidade comprovada de trabalhar de forma autônoma , gerenciando o próprio tempo, prioridades e entregas em ambiente 100% remoto.
  • Inglês nível avançado/ fluente (usará inglês no dia a dia).

Perfil Compartimental (o que esperamos de você)

  • Autonomia e protagonismo: capacidade de conduzir o trabalho de ponta a ponta com mínima supervisão, propondo soluções em vez de apenas reportar problemas.

  • Resolução de problemas: postura proativa para destravar entregas, lidar com ambiguidade e propor caminhos práticos diante de cenários complexos.
  • Organização e disciplina: capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas demandas, prazos e clientes simultaneamente sem perder qualidade ou prazo.
  • Comunicação clara e objetiva: habilidade de traduzir análises técnicas em mensagens compreensíveis para sócios e gestores de diferentes níveis.
  • Postura consultiva: atuação como parceiro estratégico do cliente, e não apenas como executor de relatórios.

Maturidade profissional e ética: discrição no trato com informações sensíveis e confidenciais.

ITTConnect is seeking a Senior Network Engineer to work remotely from anywhere in Brazil for a client in the US.

MUST BE fluent in English.

The Senior Network Engineer provides advanced networking expertise within the Managed Services organization and serves as a subject matter expert and senior escalation point for complex network and firewall issues.

In addition to resolving advanced incidents, this role contributes to technical leadership, root cause analysis, documentation, and the planning and implementation of network solutions delivered through Professional Services engagements.

Senior Network Engineers are expected to have deep expertise in enterprise networking and advanced firewall management across multiple platforms, with a strong focus on security, stability, and scalability of client environments.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the full lifecycle of complex network and firewall incidents, from detection through resolution and post-incident review, ensuring accountability for technical outcomes, stability, and documentation.
  • Lead investigation and resolution of critical network incidents, driving coordination across internal teams, vendors, and customer stakeholders.
  • Make technical decisions and take end-to-end ownership of network issues, driving resolution without reliance on further escalation.
  • Lead technical delivery of network projects, including scoping, estimation, design, and implementation.
  • Perform root cause analysis and develop long-term remediation strategies to prevent recurrence.
  • Validate and approve network changes, designs, and remediation strategies.
  • Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Cisco, Palo Alto, and Fortinet networking and firewall equipment.
  • Conduct targeted cleanup and improvements of existing network environments to ensure stability and scalability, minimizing customer downtime.
  • Collaborate with the security team to ensure proper network hardening is in place and that all risks are properly mitigated or remediated.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers.
  • Contribute to architecture documentation, diagrams, and operational runbooks.
  • Maintain awareness of developments within the networking and security technology landscape, recommending new solutions when necessary.
  • Accurately track time and project activities within the company's time tracking system.

Requirements

  • 10+ years of experience within an MSP, VAR, ISP, NOC, or enterprise IT environment, with a focus on troubleshooting and maintaining existing network infrastructure.
  • MUST BE fluent in English.
  • Advanced, hands-on experience managing enterprise firewalls across multiple platforms — including Cisco (ASA/FTD/FMC), Palo Alto Networks (PAN-OS, Panorama), and Fortinet (FortiGate, FortiManager) — including policy design, rule optimization, VPN configuration, and threat prevention.
  • Strong knowledge of networking protocols and technologies including TCP/IP, OSPF, BGP, EIGRP, IPSec, SNMP, STP, VTP, and VLANs.
  • Strong knowledge of network infrastructure within virtualized environments using VMware or similar platforms, including virtual networking, VLAN configurations, virtual switches, and network segmentation.
  • Experience troubleshooting performance and connectivity issues across different OSI layers.
  • Experience with application-level network troubleshooting, including packet inspection and analysis.
  • Proven experience optimizing, securing, and consolidating complex legacy network environments to meet current and future business needs.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with a customer-first approach to resolving network issues.

Preferred

  • Active CCNP certification or equivalent (Palo Alto PCNSE or Fortinet NSE 4/7 also valued).
  • Experience with Cisco Unified Communications Manager (CUCM) and enterprise voice/unified communications infrastructure.
  • Experience with cloud networking across AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform, including networking configurations, security settings, and integration with on-premises environments.
  • Experience with network security practices including network hardening, monitoring, and threat assessment.
  • Experience working in a Managed Service Provider (MSP) environment with exposure to ITIL-based service delivery models.

title: Servicenow Application Portfolio Management (Apm) & Data Quality Engineer - Contractor In Usd
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Servicenow Application Portfolio Management (Apm) & Data Quality Engineer - Contractor In Usd em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

For our international customer in Valencia, we are looking for a ServiceNow Application Portfolio Management (APM) & Data Quality Engineer. The role focuses on ongoing APM data maintenance in ServiceNow (APM/CMDB-related records as applicable), identifying data gaps and inconsistencies, coordinating updates with application/service owners, and tracking technical debt indicators and remediation progress.

EU candidates are welcome to apply. Candidates need to be based in Valencia or willing to relocate to Valencia. Candidates need to be flexible to work across time zones, including alignment with US Eastern Time where required.

Work permit is not provided. Candidates need to be fluent in English.

Tasks and responsibilities:

  • Perform ongoing maintenance of Application Portfolio Management (APM) data within ServiceNow, including application inventory, ownership, lifecycle status, technology attributes, and documented integrations/dependencies, ensuring data accuracy, completeness, and currency;
  • Identify and remediate data quality issues such as missing or invalid values, duplicate records, and inconsistent classifications through coordination with application owners, service owners, and relevant stakeholders;
  • Maintain and enhance portfolio data governance standards and controlled vocabularies, including lifecycle states, business and technical fit assessments, and application criticality classifications;
  • Monitor and track technical debt indicators leveraging ServiceNow portfolio data, including lifecycle and obsolescence risks, unsupported technologies, architectural non-conformities, and resilience or operability gaps;
  • Maintain a centralized log or aligned ServiceNow records documenting technical debt items, including impacted applications/services, severity and priority ratings, and recommended remediation actions such as retirement, replacement, or modernization;
  • Develop and deliver recurring dashboards, reports, and portfolio insights for the onsite Enterprise Architect, including technical debt trends, aging remediation items, progress tracking, and portfolio risk hotspots;
  • Translate stakeholder inputs, priorities, and publishing schedules into updates for the APM website and related communication materials;
  • Maintain and support the APM website as a central platform for publishing portfolio data, standards, insights, lifecycle guidance, and reference information related to Application Portfolio Management practices;

Profile:

  • Master’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline;
  • +8 years of overall experience in Information Technology;
  • +3 years of experience supporting Enterprise Architects or working within Enterprise Architecture teams;
  • Hands‑on experience with ServiceNow, specifically supporting Application Portfolio Management (APM) data, including application and CMDB records, data validation, monitoring, maintenance, and reporting;
  • Strong understanding of Application Portfolio Management (APM) principles, including application inventory management, lifecycle governance, business and technical fit assessments, risk and obsolescence analysis, and application rationalization strategies (retire, replace, modernize);
  • Proven experience identifying, documenting, and tracking technical debt, including the definition of debt indicators, maintenance of remediation records, and generation of actionable reporting and insights;
  • Solid understanding of Enterprise Architecture concepts and practices, including architecture principles, standards, governance, target‑state architecture, roadmaps, and architecture deliverables, as well as the role of portfolio data in strategic decision‑making;
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with distributed stakeholders to resolve data quality issues and drive timely completion of application and portfolio record updates;
  • Previous experience delivering similar ServiceNow APM and technical debt management activities within large or complex enterprise environments is highly preferred;
  • Strong analytical, reporting, and problem‑solving capabilities, including experience producing dashboards, scorecards, KPI reporting, and trend analysis with a strong focus on data integrity and attention to detail;
  • AI literacy, including practical experience using AI and Generative AI tools to enhance productivity in areas such as data analysis, reporting, documentation, and knowledge management, within approved enterprise governance frameworks;
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document processes, prepare executive‑ready materials, and communicate findings effectively to Enterprise Architects and business stakeholders;
  • Working knowledge of Enterprise Architecture frameworks and methodologies such as TOGAF and their practical application in enterprise architecture deliverables and governance processes;
  • Working knowledge of ServiceNow data model fundamentals relevant to Application Portfolio Management, including CMDB structures, application records, CSDM concepts, and portfolio data governance practices;

Relevant certifications are considered an advantage, including:

  • TOGAF or equivalent Enterprise Architecture certification;
  • ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA);
  • ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) and/or relevant ServiceNow implementation certifications related to APM or CMDB;

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.

Role Overview

We are seeking an expert-level, highly skilled Cloud Systems Engineer (DevOps) to serve as a GCP Specialist and technical builder for our Google Cloud ecosystem. This role requires more than administration; you must be capable of building architectural change, adjusting systems, and driving modernization efforts. You will be responsible for the end-to-end management of our GCP infrastructure, from complex networking to proactive cost optimization and resource scaling. A key responsibility is leading and running large-scale cloud migration projects, specifically from AWS to GCP.

The ideal candidate ensures our Compute Engine environment is lean, fast, and resilient while maintaining secure connectivity using both native and third-party VPN solutions.

The role’s primary focus demands deep GCP expertise, but candidates must also possess significant experience with AWS for successful migration

Key Responsibilities

  • Infrastructure & Networking: Configure and maintain robust networking architectures, including Cloud DNS and Cloud NAT.
  • Linux System Administration: Manage and maintain the operating system environment on Compute Engine instances, including patching, configuration management, user account management, and troubleshooting core system issues.
  • VPN Management: Build and manage secure tunnels using Cloud VPN , pfSense virtual appliances, and CloudConnexa (OpenVPN) for flexible remote access.
  • Performance Monitoring: Utilize Google Cloud Operations Suite to monitor Compute Engine health. Identify bottlenecks and tune instances for peak performance.
  • Resource Management: Oversee persistent disks, snapshots, and storage buckets. Ensure high availability while purging unused resources to maintain environment hygiene.
  • Cost Optimization: Actively monitor billing dashboards, implement committed use discounts (CUDs), and right-size underutilized instances to maintain a lean budget.
  • Database Oversight: Provide support for PostgreSQL and Oracle environments, ensuring seamless integration and performance within the GCP ecosystem.
  • Security & Compliance : Enforce IAM roles and security best practices to protect the project perimeter

Required Qualifications

  • Containerization Mastery: Strong expertise with Docker for containerizing applications, managing images, and troubleshooting container runtimes.
  • Scripting Mastery: High proficiency in Python or Bash for automating routine infrastructure tasks, reporting, and task scheduling.
  • Networking Expertise: Hands-on experience managing network routing, firewall rules, and site-to-site VPNs using pfSense and CloudConnexa.
  • Cloud Migration & Project Leadership: Proven experience leading and running application and data migrations from AWS to GCP. This includes the capability to own the end-to-end migration project life cycle and drive solutions.
  • Compute Engine Mastery: Deep understanding of VM lifecycles, custom machine types, and auto-scaling.
  • English Proficiency: Advanced English level (B2–C1 or higher)

Nice-to-Have

  • PostgreSQL Expertise: Strong hands-on experience with configuration, optimization, and query tuning.
  • Oracle Expertise: Experience managing or migrating Oracle database environments.
  • Data & Analytics: Familiarity with BigQuery.

We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule).
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.

As this is an English-speaking role, we kindly ask that all applications be submitted with a CV in English.

For our international customer in Valencia, we are looking for a ServiceNow Application Portfolio Management (APM) & Data Quality Engineer. The role focuses on ongoing APM data maintenance in ServiceNow (APM/CMDB-related records as applicable), identifying data gaps and inconsistencies, coordinating updates with application/service owners, and tracking technical debt indicators and remediation progress.

EU candidates are welcome to apply. Candidates need to be based in Valencia or willing to relocate to Valencia. Candidates need to be flexible to work across time zones, including alignment with US Eastern Time where required.

Work permit is not provided. Candidates need to be fluent in English.

Tasks and responsibilities:

  • Perform ongoing maintenance of Application Portfolio Management (APM) data within ServiceNow, including application inventory, ownership, lifecycle status, technology attributes, and documented integrations/dependencies, ensuring data accuracy, completeness, and currency;
  • Identify and remediate data quality issues such as missing or invalid values, duplicate records, and inconsistent classifications through coordination with application owners, service owners, and relevant stakeholders;
  • Maintain and enhance portfolio data governance standards and controlled vocabularies, including lifecycle states, business and technical fit assessments, and application criticality classifications;
  • Monitor and track technical debt indicators leveraging ServiceNow portfolio data, including lifecycle and obsolescence risks, unsupported technologies, architectural non-conformities, and resilience or operability gaps;
  • Maintain a centralized log or aligned ServiceNow records documenting technical debt items, including impacted applications/services, severity and priority ratings, and recommended remediation actions such as retirement, replacement, or modernization;
  • Develop and deliver recurring dashboards, reports, and portfolio insights for the onsite Enterprise Architect, including technical debt trends, aging remediation items, progress tracking, and portfolio risk hotspots;
  • Translate stakeholder inputs, priorities, and publishing schedules into updates for the APM website and related communication materials;
  • Maintain and support the APM website as a central platform for publishing portfolio data, standards, insights, lifecycle guidance, and reference information related to Application Portfolio Management practices;

Profile:

  • Master’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline;
  • +8 years of overall experience in Information Technology;
  • +3 years of experience supporting Enterprise Architects or working within Enterprise Architecture teams;
  • Hands‑on experience with ServiceNow, specifically supporting Application Portfolio Management (APM) data, including application and CMDB records, data validation, monitoring, maintenance, and reporting;
  • Strong understanding of Application Portfolio Management (APM) principles, including application inventory management, lifecycle governance, business and technical fit assessments, risk and obsolescence analysis, and application rationalization strategies (retire, replace, modernize);
  • Proven experience identifying, documenting, and tracking technical debt, including the definition of debt indicators, maintenance of remediation records, and generation of actionable reporting and insights;
  • Solid understanding of Enterprise Architecture concepts and practices, including architecture principles, standards, governance, target‑state architecture, roadmaps, and architecture deliverables, as well as the role of portfolio data in strategic decision‑making;
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with distributed stakeholders to resolve data quality issues and drive timely completion of application and portfolio record updates;
  • Previous experience delivering similar ServiceNow APM and technical debt management activities within large or complex enterprise environments is highly preferred;
  • Strong analytical, reporting, and problem‑solving capabilities, including experience producing dashboards, scorecards, KPI reporting, and trend analysis with a strong focus on data integrity and attention to detail;
  • AI literacy, including practical experience using AI and Generative AI tools to enhance productivity in areas such as data analysis, reporting, documentation, and knowledge management, within approved enterprise governance frameworks;
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document processes, prepare executive‑ready materials, and communicate findings effectively to Enterprise Architects and business stakeholders;
  • Working knowledge of Enterprise Architecture frameworks and methodologies such as TOGAF and their practical application in enterprise architecture deliverables and governance processes;
  • Working knowledge of ServiceNow data model fundamentals relevant to Application Portfolio Management, including CMDB structures, application records, CSDM concepts, and portfolio data governance practices;

Relevant certifications are considered an advantage, including:

  • TOGAF or equivalent Enterprise Architecture certification;
  • ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA);
  • ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) and/or relevant ServiceNow implementation certifications related to APM or CMDB;
  • Experience with enterprise architecture and portfolio management tooling, including ServiceNow EA Workspace and APM reporting capabilities;
  • Familiarity with responsible AI principles and the secure use of enterprise AI assistants, including prompt hygiene and protection of sensitive information;

title: Integration Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Integration Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Anterior is on a mission to transform healthcare administration, making it seamless and invisible so clinicians can focus on delivering care. We’ve built an AI-powered platform designed by clinicians, for clinicians, to simplify administrative workflows and improve patient outcomes. By combining clinical expertise with cutting-edge technology, we’re revolutionizing healthcare operations with responsible AI.

We’re growing rapidly and are backed by world-class investors including Sequoia, New Enterprise Associates NEA, and Neo along with notable angels including the founders of DeepMind, Google AI, and Inflection AI.

Anterior is improving the experience of healthcare for everyone. We’re working on the cutting edge of using technology to make clinical decision-making frictionless.We’re building exciting tech for huge customers and we trust in the foundations: keep it simple, build strong foundations, and the rest will follow.

The Team

At Anterior, engineers share a strong “sense of product” and solve meaningful problems that simplify healthcare workflows. We collaborate in multidisciplinary teams to deliver secure, scalable, and user-focused solutions guided by best practices and modular design.

We’re building a dedicated deployments team focused on deploying our platform into large US enterprise healthcare environments. This team works closely with customers and our core platform engineers to ensure seamless, reliable integrations into complex payer systems of record.

About You

You have a passion for doing things The Right Way, you believe Less is More, you want to focus on the foundations of system design and architecture (pacelc, consistency guarantees), you care as much about the code you do not write, you’re tired of the hype treadmill and care about the fundamentals. You have battle scars from over-engineered and underperforming slop, and you care about writing code that lasts.

Your depth is in building integrations, APIs, and data pipelines that connect complex systems together reliably. You’ve worked with enterprise customers, dealt with messy data, conflicting sources of truth, and deduplication challenges.

You’ve owned integration design decisions end-to-end — from scoping requirements with a customer to shipping it to production and making sure it holds up. You may be coming from a health tech company, a scale-up doing enterprise deployments, or a platform team that built the connective tissue between systems — what matters is that you’ve navigated real integration complexity and you want ownership over what you build.

About the Role

Members of Technical Staff (Deployments) at Anterior own customer deployment problems end-to-end — from scoping integrations through to production. You’ll be the bridge between our AI platform and the enterprise healthcare systems it plugs into.

A day’s work may include:

  • Designing and building integrations, APIs, and data pipelines that connect our platform to customer systems of record EHRs, claims platforms, care management systems)
  • Working directly with US enterprise healthcare customers to understand their architecture, scope integration requirements, and translate them into technical specs
  • Building and maintaining FHIR, HL7, and custom API integrations with payer and health plan systems
  • Debugging data quality issues — conflicting sources of truth, deduplication, schema mismatches, and edge cases specific to healthcare data
  • Owning UAT testing end-to-end, working with customer IT teams to validate data flows before go-live
  • Building internal tooling and shared integration patterns that make the next deployment faster
  • Contributing to Anterior’s SDKs, developer documentation, and integration playbooks
  • Collaborating closely with the core platform team in New York to ensure integration needs inform platform architecture

Tech

  • Infra: Nix, AWS
  • Healthcare data: FHIR, HL7 (experience preferred but not required — you’ll learn fast if you have strong API and data pipeline fundamentals)

What we’re looking for

  • Experience integrating with enterprise systems, ideally in healthcare (payer, EHR, claims) but complex enterprise integrations in other industries count too
  • Comfort working directly with customers and translating ambiguous requirements into clean technical solutions
  • Experience with data quality challenges — deduplication, schema mapping, reconciliation across multiple sources of truth
  • Strong written and spoken communication in English — you’ll be collaborating with teams and customers across time zones
  • Ability to work autonomously from detailed technical specs while flagging blockers and ambiguity early
  • Timezone compatibility with US East Coast ET) working hours

What’s in it for you

This is an opportunity to join a company at its major inflection point, using cutting- edge technology to have a meaningful impact in healthcare. You’ll work with a world-class team, hold significant responsibility, and have the opportunity to learn and grow rapidly.

We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule).
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.

As this is an English-speaking role, we kindly ask that all applications be submitted with a CV in English.

  • Translate stakeholder inputs, priorities, and publishing schedules into updates for the APM website and related communication materials;
  • Maintain and support the APM website as a central platform for publishing portfolio data, standards, insights, lifecycle guidance, and reference information related to Application Portfolio Management practices;

Profile:

  • Master’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline;
  • +8 years of overall experience in Information Technology;
  • +3 years of experience supporting Enterprise Architects or working within Enterprise Architecture teams;
  • Hands‑on experience with ServiceNow, specifically supporting Application Portfolio Management (APM) data, including application and CMDB records, data validation, monitoring, maintenance, and reporting;
  • Strong understanding of Application Portfolio Management (APM) principles, including application inventory management, lifecycle governance, business and technical fit assessments, risk and obsolescence analysis, and application rationalization strategies (retire, replace, modernize);
  • Proven experience identifying, documenting, and tracking technical debt, including the definition of debt indicators, maintenance of remediation records, and generation of actionable reporting and insights;
  • Solid understanding of Enterprise Architecture concepts and practices, including architecture principles, standards, governance, target‑state architecture, roadmaps, and architecture deliverables, as well as the role of portfolio data in strategic decision‑making;
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with distributed stakeholders to resolve data quality issues and drive timely completion of application and portfolio record updates;
  • Previous experience delivering similar ServiceNow APM and technical debt management activities within large or complex enterprise environments is highly preferred;
  • Strong analytical, reporting, and problem‑solving capabilities, including experience producing dashboards, scorecards, KPI reporting, and trend analysis with a strong focus on data integrity and attention to detail;
  • AI literacy, including practical experience using AI and Generative AI tools to enhance productivity in areas such as data analysis, reporting, documentation, and knowledge management, within approved enterprise governance frameworks;
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document processes, prepare executive‑ready materials, and communicate findings effectively to Enterprise Architects and business stakeholders;
  • Working knowledge of Enterprise Architecture frameworks and methodologies such as TOGAF and their practical application in enterprise architecture deliverables and governance processes;
  • Working knowledge of ServiceNow data model fundamentals relevant to Application Portfolio Management, including CMDB structures, application records, CSDM concepts, and portfolio data governance practices;

Relevant certifications are considered an advantage, including:

  • TOGAF or equivalent Enterprise Architecture certification;
  • ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA);
  • ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) and/or relevant ServiceNow implementation certifications related to APM or CMDB;
  • Experience with enterprise architecture and portfolio management tooling, including ServiceNow EA Workspace and APM reporting capabilities;
  • Familiarity with responsible AI principles and the secure use of enterprise AI assistants, including prompt hygiene and protection of sensitive information;

Headshots.com is transforming how professional headshots are delivered. Trusted by enterprise clients such as Boeing, Netflix, and American Express, we produce studio-quality headshots from smartphone images—backed by world-class production and technology.

Our retouching team is critical to delivering consistent, natural, high-quality results at scale. We are hiring experienced headshot retouchers for ongoing work who can handle high volume while maintaining realism, accuracy, and professional polish.

Role Overview

This role focuses on high-quality retouching of professional headshots sourced from mobile phone photos. You will work within established production standards to deliver natural, realistic results—preserving skin texture, correcting lighting issues, and ensuring consistency across batches.

Following a brief unpaid test project, selected candidates will invited for an interview, with the opportunity for long-term, steady work.

Core Responsibilities

Image Retouching & Quality Control

  • Retouch professional headshots from phone photos with a natural, realistic finish
  • Correct skin tone, noise, mixed lighting, exposure issues, and soft focus
  • Reduce or remove glasses glare while preserving realism
  • Perform background swaps and composites that look seamless and believable
  • Maintain consistency and quality across large batches of images

Production & Workflow Discipline

  • Deliver work on time and meet daily/weekly volume expectations
  • Follow established retouching guidelines and quality standards
  • Apply feedback consistently and efficiently
  • Communicate clearly if issues arise that could affect timelines or quality

Core Skills Required

  • Natural skin retouching (texture preserved; no plastic or over-processed look)
  • Clean hair masking and edge work (no halos)
  • Realistic background compositing
  • Strong color correction and exposure balancing, especially in uneven or mixed light
  • Excellent time management and consistency at scale
  • Strong written English (spoken English for occasional Zoom calls is a plus)

Hardware & Software Requirements (Must-Have)

  • Graphics tablet (Wacom, Huion, XP-Pen, or similar)
  • Legitimate Adobe Photoshop subscription (no cracked software)
  • MacBook Pro Retina or equivalent high-quality PC laptop display
  • Monitor accurate in sRGB (DCI-P3 support is a plus)

Volume, Timing & Pay

  • Expected volume after trial period: 100+ images/month, with potential to scale higher
  • The $2,000/month reference rate is based on completing approximately 20 headshots per day across 20 working days

Application Requirements (Read Carefully)

Apply by completing the test project:

Hiring Process

  • Applicants are asked to complete a brief unpaid test project
  • Successful test submissions will be invited to interview
  • Ongoing, consistent work available for high-performing retouchers
  • Direct inquiries will disqualify candidates. All applications must be submitted through Indeed.
  • Job Types: Full-time, Contract

IMPORTANT

All candidates must apply via LinkedIn. Direct contact with Headshots.com regarding this position will not be considered and may result in disqualification from the process.

Programa de Trainee de Operações — Mottu

Na Mottu, acreditamos no poder da mobilidade e da inovação para transformar vidas. Fundada em 2020, somos hoje a maior empresa de aluguel de motos do mundo, com mais de123 mil motos em circulação e presença em mais de145 filiais no Brasil e México.

Em setembro de 2023, concluímos nossa rodada Series C deUS$ 50 milhões , liderada por grandes nomes do Venture Capital, como Crankstart Foundation, Bicycle Capital e QED Investors.

Somos a startup que mais cresce na América Latina e estamos no caminho para conquistar o status deunicórnio ainda em 2025 . Acreditamos em um mundo conectado e simplificado, com soluções tecnológicas que geram impacto real na vida das pessoas.

Nossos princípios guiam todas as nossas decisões e ações:

  • Excelência como padrão: Não nos conformamos com o mediano. Buscamos sempre o excepcional.
  • Foco no cliente: Existimos para gerar oportunidades para quem nunca as teve.
  • Cabeça de dono: Tomamos decisões com coragem, autonomia e responsabilidade.
  • Mão na graxa: Colocamos a mão na massa para entender e melhorar cada processo.
  • Ombro a ombro: Trabalhamos com transparência, colaboração e espírito coletivo.

Se você busca crescimento acelerado, desafios reais e quer fazer parte de uma revolução na mobilidade, a Mottu é o lugar certo. Venha construir o futuro conosco!

Trainee de Operações

Como Trainee de Operações, você será peça fundamental na rotina e evolução das nossas operações. Atuará diretamente na melhoria contínua dos processos, com forte participação na análise de dados, execução de projetos e suporte estratégico às operações das filiais.

Esse programa é ideal para quem deseja desenvolver uma carreira sólida em operações, com possibilidades de crescimento para cargos comoCity Manager ,Trainee de Negócios na Matriz ouTrainee de Operações na expansão internacional da Mottu .

Responsabilidades

  • Analisar indicadores operacionais e identificar oportunidades de melhoria;
  • Desenvolver e implementar projetos de rotina e melhoria contínua;
  • Apoiar o(a) City Manager na gestão operacional da filial;
  • Atuar como ponte entre o time de campo e as áreas estratégicas da companhia;
  • Propor soluções inovadoras que gerem impacto direto no negócio.

Requisitos

Habilidades Necessárias

  • Formação em Engenharias ou áreas correlatas;
  • Conhecimentos em análise de dados (Excel avançado, PROCV, INDEX + MATCH, tabelas dinâmicas);
  • Boa comunicação e trabalho em equipe;
  • Proatividade e autonomia para resolução de problemas;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de BI (como Power BI ou similares).

Habilidades Desejáveis

  • Conhecimento em SQL;
  • Experiência com Power BI;
  • Noções de Python;
  • Programação orientada a objeto

Nós da Mottu acreditamos no poder de transformar vidas através da mobilidade e da inovação. Fundada em 2020, somos hoje a maior empresa de aluguel de motos do mundo, com mais de 170.000 motos em circulação e presença em mais de 100 filiais no Brasil e no México. Em setembro de 2023, concluímos nossa rodada Series C de US$ 50 milhões, liderada por grandes nomes do Venture Capital, como Crankstart Foundation, Bicycle Capital e QED Investors.

Somos a startup que mais cresce na América Latina e atingimos ainda em 2025 o status de unicórnio. Acreditamos em um mundo conectado e simplificado, com soluções tecnológicas que melhoram vidas. Valorizamos a superação, a igualdade e a união para construir juntos e transformar a forma como pensamos e agimos. Nós somos Mottu.

Nossos princípios inspiram cada passo da nossa trajetória e guiam nossas ações. Acreditamos no medo de ser mediano e, por isso, não nos conformamos com nada menos do que o excepcional: pensar grande e pensar pequeno dá o mesmo trabalho, então damos cada dia 10% a mais do que conseguimos dar no anterior, sempre buscando a grandeza e a escalabilidade. Nosso Foco no Cliente é inegociável, pois nascemos para dar oportunidade a quem nunca teve uma e somos obstinados em ajudá-los a conquistar seus sonhos. Mantemos a Cabeça de Dono, tomando decisões com coragem, autonomia e responsabilidade para deixar um legado com paixão e “sangue nos olhos”. Com Mão na Graxa, arregaçamos as mangas e fazemos nós mesmos para entender e melhorar cada processo, respeitando sempre a opinião de quem está na ponta da lança. E atuamos Ombro a Ombro, apoiando-nos mutuamente, cultivando relações genuínas, sinceras e duradouras, com a coragem de falar a verdade — afinal, aqui não há espaço para jogar em primeira pessoa.

Se você busca crescimento acelerado, desafios constantes e deseja fazer parte da nossa missão de revolucionar a mobilidade, a Mottu é o lugar certo para você! Venha somar ao time e construir conosco o futuro da mobilidade na América Latina.

description:

O(A) Analista de Processos será o(a) guardião(ã) da Qualidade e da Eficiência Operacional da Flexmaker. O principal desafio é garantir a aderência aos padrões de qualidade estabelecidos, monitorar a performance de metas em todos os setores e atuar na padronização e documentação dos procedimentos, assegurando que a rotina da empresa esteja em conformidade com as normas internas e regulamentações relevantes (ex: ISO 9001 e normas ANVISA para produtos médicos/hospitalares).
Experiência: Sólida experiência como Analista de Processos, Qualidade ou áreas correlatas.

  • Conhecimento: Experiência prática com implementação e manutenção de Sistemas de Gestão da Qualidade (SGQ) , preferencialmente baseado na ISO 9001 .
  • Diferencial: Conhecimento em regulamentações do setor de Saúde (ANVISA) será considerado um grande diferencial.
  • Habilidades: Excelentes habilidades de análise de dados, comunicação interpessoal e atenção a detalhes.

. Gestão de Metas e Performance

  • Realizar o acompanhamento semanal e mensal das metas por setor (Financeiro, Comercial, Produção, Logística, RH, Qualidade), atualizando o Plano de Metas.
  • Analisar e resumir relatórios de eficiência, eficácia e produtividade (vindos de ferramentas como ClickUp), pontuando a meritocracia e a performance.
  • Coordenar a gestão à vista, garantindo que o status de metas, KPIs e resultados de projetos sejam visíveis e acessíveis a todos os colaboradores.

2. Qualidade e Conformidade

  • Manter e Gerenciar o Sistema de Gestão da Qualidade (SGQ) , incluindo a organização e manutenção da documentação (Manuais, Procedimentos e Registros).
  • Assegurar que os processos da empresa estejam em conformidade com normas relevantes (ex: ISO 9001 e normas específicas da ANVISA, se aplicável ao negócio).
  • Criar e gerenciar a documentação de padronização, como a elaboração de Instruções de Trabalho (ITs) e Procedimentos Operacionais Padrão (POPs), em conjunto com os gestores.

3. Auditoria e Controle

  • Coordenar e executar auditorias internas dos processos, rotinas, entradas e saídas (RSI) em todos os setores para verificar a aderência aos padrões de qualidade.
  • Criar e executar o cronograma de auditoria cruzada entre setores (Gestão de 5S).
  • Realizar a cobrança de procedimentos, registros e ocorrências (NC, OM, OG, Desvios e RSI) através de auditorias e reuniões.

4. Treinamento e Melhoria Contínua

  • Em conjunto com o RH, planejar e ministrar treinamentos sobre normas, procedimentos, Boas Práticas de Fabricação (BPF) e a importância da cultura de qualidade e segurança.
  • Acompanhar e checar a meta de integração/maturidade de novos colaboradores, em parceria com o RH.
  • Apresentar e sugerir ações de melhoria de processos que gerem resultados tangíveis.

  • Levantar dados cirúrgicos/obstétricos para elaboração da estatística mensal com base no fluxo de registros;
  • Realizar notificação das ocorrências referente a assistência à saúde;
  • Assegurar os primeiros cuidados necessários ao recém‑nascido, incluindo sua identificação e encaminhá‑lo ao Berçário ou UCI Neonatal, conforme procedimento específico, obedecendo protocolos institucionais;

  • Conferir a digitação da nota de sala, protocolando‑a para o envio do documento sempre que necessário;
  • Disponibilizar a sala para a higienização e conferir ao término;
  • Assegurar a montagem da sala para o procedimento subsequente;
  • Realizar/certificar‑se da identificação, pesagem e acondicionamento das peças cirúrgicas/placentas, em formol, retiradas do paciente, e o seu encaminhamento para exames diagnóstico ou sepultamento;
  • Preencher a Declaração de Nascidos Vivos para o encaminhamento junto com o recém‑nascido.

  • Formação superior em Enfermagem;
  • COREN ativo;
  • Especialização em Obstetrícia;
  • Experiência na área de centro obstétrico e classificação de risco;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em escala mista 12x36h

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Go-to-Market Engineer - Salvador, Brazil em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Mission

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning. Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

About SIMBA Voice Agents by Speechify

SIMBA lets companies deploy natural, human-sounding AI voice agents in 71+ languages with sub-second latency. We're growing fast and need the systems to match — which means building the outbound engine, sales infrastructure, and automation stack that fills pipeline and keeps it moving.
About the Role

We're hiring our first GTM Engineer for SIMBA. You'll build and own the technical systems that power our outbound motion — from lead enrichment and sequencing to CRM architecture and AI-powered personalization at scale.

This is purely an infrastructure and systems role. You'll be the person behind the scenes making sure the right prospects get the right message at the right time, and that the Sales team has the tooling and data to close. If you've built outbound systems from scratch, live inside Clay and Apollo, and measure your work in pipeline influenced — read on.

What You'll Do

  • Build and maintain SIMBA's outbound infrastructure — lead sourcing, enrichment pipelines, scoring models, and sequencing workflows that run at scale
  • Own the GTM tech stack end-to-end: CRM (HubSpot/Salesforce), enrichment (Clay, Apollo, Clearbit), sequencing (Outreach, Instantly), and the glue between them
  • Deploy AI agents for automated prospect research, personalized outreach generation, and follow-up workflows — reducing manual work for the Sales team
  • Instrument the full top-of-funnel: track what's working, cut what isn't, and continuously optimize for meetings booked and pipeline created
  • Build integrations and automations via APIs, webhooks, and tools like Zapier/Make to keep data clean and systems in sync
  • Evaluate and adopt new AI and GTM tooling rapidly — be the team's resident expert on what's emerging and what's worth building on

What We're Looking For

  • Solid experience in GTM engineering, growth engineering, or RevOps role with a heavy technical lean
  • You've personally built outbound systems from scratch — enrichment pipelines, multi-step sequences, lead scoring — not just managed existing ones
  • Deep hands-on experience with the modern GTM stack: Clay, Apollo, HubSpot or Salesforce, Outreach or Instantly, Zapier/Make, Webhooks, REST APIs
  • You think in funnels and measure everything — pipeline influenced, reply rates, meeting conversion, and cost per opportunity are metrics you track obsessively
  • You ship fast, keep things simple, and don't wait for permission

Nice to Have

  • Experience building GTM systems for an AI, voice, or developer-tools product
  • Familiarity with contact center, CX, or telephony buyer personas
  • Background at a B2C company that also runs a B2B or API sales motion

Why Speechify SIMBA

Build a product that genuinely impresses prospects — sub-second latency and 71+ languages speaks for itself. You'll have high ownership with direct input on GTM strategy, work alongside a team that stays embedded with customers, and operate in a fast-moving environment where your systems have outsized impact.

WHY JOIN US
If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!
ABOUT THE ROLE
We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to own production reliability and troubleshooting on a high-scale live hiring events platform serving enterprise clients. You will diagnose and resolve issues across distributed backend systems built on Java, Spring Boot, and Kafka, while collaborating closely with Client Support and GTM teams to maintain SLA compliance. The role demands rapid execution, strong React frontend experience, and the ability to take ownership across multiple concurrent projects.
WHAT YOU WILL DO
- Analyze, troubleshoot, and resolve production issues related to live hiring events and platform functionality;
- Diagnose problems across distributed systems, integrations, and event workflows;
- Collaborate closely with Client Support and GTM teams to triage and resolve support tickets efficiently;
- Ensure timely issue resolution in accordance with established SLAs;
- Monitor production systems and respond quickly to alerts, incidents, or performance degradation;
- Maintain and update event logic as platform dependencies and integrations evolve;
- Contribute to architecture improvements, backend reliability, and system scalability initiatives;
- Own code merges, deployments, and production changes with minimal supervision;
- Support and onboard additional engineers as the team grows;
- Provide technical leadership, guidance, and operational support across multiple projects.
MUST HAVES
- 5+ years of professional software engineering experience ;
- Strong backend development experience with Java and Spring Boot ;
- Strong backend development experience with Python and Django ;
- Strong frontend experience with React ;
- Experience working with Kafka , GraphQL , and SQL and/or MongoDB ;
- Experience with build systems, CI/CD pipelines , and deployment processes;
- Proven ability to ramp up quickly and take ownership of multiple projects simultaneously;
- Experience troubleshooting and resolving production issues in live environments;
- Experience with at least one of the following: Dagster , Data Lakes , or Amazon Athena ;
- Strong debugging and data-analysis skills for investigating production incidents;
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills;
- Upper-intermediate English level.
NICE TO HAVES
- Product Management experience or close collaboration with GTM and Engineering teams on prioritization initiatives;
- Experience with AI-assisted development tools such as Claude , Cursor , or Windsurf ;
- Experience mentoring or leading engineering teams in high-growth environments.
PERKS AND BENEFITS
- Professional growth : Mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
- Competitive compensation : USD-based pay with education, fitness, and team activity budgets.
- Exciting projects : Modern solutions with Fortune 500 and top product companies.

  • Liderar a implementação e sustentação de projetos SAP, garantindo governança sobre prazos, escopo, qualidade, riscos e orçamento, com foco em ambientes críticos e de alta complexidade;

title: Coordenador de Engenharia Integrada (Manutenção, Automação e Processos)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Coordenador de Engenharia Integrada (Manutenção, Automação e Processos) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Na Newell Brands, temos orgulho de ser uma empresa líder global em bens de consumo, com mais de 50 marcas icônicas que podem ser encontradas em lares ao redor do mundo, incluindo Oster®, Cadence®, NUK®, Lillo®, Invicta®, Contigo®, Coleman®, Rubbermaid®, PaperMate®, Sharpie®, Graco® entre outras.
Estamos em uma jornada para fortalecer nossas marcas e encantar os consumidores, contando com pessoas como você para trazer perspectivas únicas e brilhar em um ambiente dinâmico.
Você fará parte de uma cultura colaborativa, solidária e respeitosa, onde valorizamos a diversidade e a singularidade de cada pessoa, reconhecendo que diferentes visões ampliam nossa capacidade de inovar e gerar impacto. Todas as candidaturas são bem-vindas, independentemente de identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, raça, etnia, religião, idade ou deficiência. Nosso compromisso é garantir processos justos e um ambiente inclusivo, onde talento e protagonismo sejam os verdadeiros critérios de crescimento.
Nome do cargo: Coordenador de Engenharia Integrada (Manutenção, Automação e Processos)
Local: Feira de Santana, BA
Reporta-se para: Gerente da planta
Responsabilidades

  • Supervisionar as atividades da área de Manutenção, Processos produtivos e Ferramentaria, definindo o plano de trabalho mediante análise de necessidades e integração de recursos, atribuindo responsabilidades e estabelecendo prazos de execução, orientando e esclarecendo dúvidas acerca das tarefas, acompanhando e controlando o fluxo de atividades, identificando pontos negativos e fatores críticos, adotando medidas preventivas e/ou corretivas, contribuindo para o aumento de produtividade e redução de custos
  • Criar e manter uma equipe de trabalho capacitada e motivada, definindo o perfil profissional, participando do processo de seleção, treinando e desenvolvendo pessoas, definindo metas e objetivos, acompanhando, avaliando e incentivando o alcance de padrões superiores de desempenho, compartilhando informações, administrando conflitos, fornecendo aconselhamento e feedback construtivo e positivo, reconhecendo e recompensando esforços e resultados, gerando oportunidades de crescimento e desenvolvimento profissional, alinhando os objetivos individuais e organizacionais, de forma a estimular a busca permanente por resultados
  • Promover e disseminar a cultura de prevenção de acidentes/incidentes de trabalho, saúde e meio ambiente, conscientizando os funcionários da importância do uso de EPI´s, bem como assegurar a correta operação dos equipamentos e manuseio de materiais
  • Contribuir para a manutenção e/ou melhoria da competitividade empresarial, analisando, avaliando e introduzindo novos conceitos, metodologias, ferramentas e tecnologias, buscando soluções alternativas face aos problemas cotidianos, propondo mudanças nos processos atuais, assegurando ganhos expressivos em termos de produtividade, qualidade e rentabilidade das operações
  • Participar da elaboração de novos projetos, recebendo demanda da área de Engenharia quanto a concepção de novos produtos ou melhoria contínua, avaliando a viabilidade, analisando os projetos, de forma a garantir a produção de produtos de acordo com as exigências do mercado e padrões de produtividade e qualidade
  • Assegurar a eficiência e produtividade dos equipamentos e das instalações das fábricas, desenvolvendo a manutenção preventiva, utilizando programas de aplicação (TPM), levantando o histórico das máquinas, observando a durabilidade das peças dos equipamentos, montando cronogramas de aplicação da TPM, preenchendo formulários apropriados, analisando futuras melhorias como alteração de fornecedores, troca peças, etc., supervisionando a execução dos serviços de instalação, envolvendo construção de máquinas e equipamentos, adequação de layout, instalações eletro-hidráulico-pneumáticas, programando paradas de máquinas para a realização de manutenção, programando os serviços referentes a pequenas instalações, serviços de manutenção ou melhoria nas instalações prediais da fábrica e escritório, projetos e obras, além de elaborar e implantar os procedimentos de trabalho para manutenção corretiva/preventiva, fazendo as alterações e adaptações conforme necessário
  • Otimizar os investimentos em máquinas, equipamentos e instalações industriais mediante estudos, análise e implantação de projetos adequados, seleção de equipamentos e fornecedores
  • Elaborar e administrar o orçamento da área, definindo os investimentos e despesas de manutenção em todas as áreas, acompanhando e controlando os gastos, realocando os valores quando necessário, de forma a alcançar as metas e objetivos propostos dentro do orçamento estabelecido
  • Assegurar o atendimento as necessidades das áreas, desenvolvendo máquinas, dispositivos e instalações, recebendo as solicitações referente as necessidades, efetuando pesquisas de viabilidades e funcionabilidade, utilizando ferramentas apropriadas quando necessárias (Auto Cad) para elaboração do projeto, reportando a chefia da Área, solicitando a execução do mesmo, acompanhando a montagem, identificando e solucionando eventuais problemas em medidas, acabamentos, etc
  • Administrar a Área de Manutenção através da organização de pessoal (avaliação de pessoal, programação de férias, transferência de turnos e funções, etc.), visando o controle de pessoal
  • Executar outras atividades correlatas
Requisitos
  • Graduação completa em Engenharia, preferencialmente Mecânica ou Elétrica
  • Experiência relevante em cargo de gestão nas áreas de Manutenção, Processos produtivos e/ou Ferramentaria
  • Inglês intermediário/avançado
  • Cursos de especialização em manutenção de máquinas e equipamentos
  • Bons conhecimentos de instalações elétricas industriais e prediais
  • Conhecimentos de máquinas e equipamentos em geral
  • Conhecimentos de ferramentas de análise e acompanhamento de projetos
  • Conhecimentos de técnicas de manutenção preditiva
  • Conhecimentos para elaboração, implementação e administração de planos de manutenção
Newell Brands (NASDAQ: NWL) is a leading global consumer goods company with a strong portfolio of well-known brands, including Rubbermaid, Sharpie, Graco, Coleman, Rubbermaid Commercial Products, Yankee Candle, Paper Mate, FoodSaver, Dymo, EXPO, Elmer’s, Oster, NUK, Spontex and Campingaz. We are focused on delighting consumers by lighting up everyday moments.

Fundado em 1961 com a criação da Profarma Distribuição, o Grupo Profarma consolidou-se como um dos líderes no mercado farmacêutico brasileiro, ocupando hoje uma relevante atuação no mercado nacional em distribuição. Acreditamos que enxergar é mais do que ver - é reconhecer as singularidades que tornam cada pessoa única. Por isso, reforçamos nosso compromisso com a Diversidade & Inclusão por meio do programa Diversidade em Cena.

description:

Descrição da vaga

Supervisionar todo o fluxo operacional do Departamento, desde o pré até o pós-procedimento, garantindo eficiência, cumprimento de prazos e qualidade nas entregas. Acompanhar a captação de cotações, envio de propostas, negociações e suporte ao time Comercial, além de assegurar o correto processamento das etapas pós-cirúrgicas, incluindo registros, autorizações, faturamento e fechamento financeiro.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Liderar o time responsável pela captação de cotações e garantir a qualidade e volume das demandas recebidas;
  • Acompanhar a elaboração, revisão e envio de orçamentos (cotações pré), assegurando agilidade, precisão e cumprimento de SLA;
  • Conduzir e orientar negociações comerciais, acompanhando taxa de conversão, rentabilidade e principais motivos de perda;
  • Acompanhar o recebimento, organização e controle dos agendamentos cirúrgicos, garantindo visibilidade e previsibilidade da operação;
  • Verificar o correto gerenciamento da agenda de cirurgias, prevenindo falhas operacionais e desalinhamentos com áreas envolvidas;
  • Validar o correto input dos pedidos e garantir o envio adequado de materiais, minimizando riscos de erro logístico;
  • Monitorar indicadores do pré-procedimento, como tempo de cotação, SLA de envio, volume e taxa de conversão;
  • Identificar gargalos operacionais no fluxo pré e propor ações corretivas e melhorias contínuas;
  • Realizar reportes estruturados ao time Comercial e à liderança, apresentando indicadores, status de autorizações, perdas e oportunidades;
  • Liderar o time responsável pelas cotações e ajustes pós-procedimento, conforme utilização real dos materiais;
  • Supervisionar o controle, conferência e consistência dos informes de uso;
  • Garantir a comunicação ativa e o acompanhamento das autorizações de faturamento junto aos clientes;
  • Validar e acompanhar o envio de pedidos para emissão de notas fiscais;
  • Supervisionar o processo de faturamento e emissão de notas fiscais, assegurando conformidade e cumprimento de prazos;
  • Monitorar pendências e inconsistências que impactem o faturamento, atuando de forma proativa na resolução;
  • Analisar a fluidez do ciclo financeiro, reduzindo atrasos, retrabalhos e índices de glosa;
  • Acompanhar indicadores do pós-procedimento, como tempo de faturamento, prazo de emissão de NF e índice de pendências;
  • Atuar de forma integrada com as áreas Comercial, Logística, Financeiro e clientes, garantindo alinhamento e eficiência dos processos.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Graduação completa nas áreas de Administração, Comercial ou Saúde;
  • Pós-graduação em andamento, em Gestão Comercial, Marketing, Gestão Hospitalar ou correlatas;
  • Microsoft Office intermediário a avançado, especialmente Excel;
  • Experiência mínima de 3 anos, no ramo de materiais médicos hospitalares;
  • Experiência com gestão de pequenas equipes;
  • Domínio dos portais de cotação, utilizados no ramo de atuação da empresa;
  • Conhecimento dos processos comerciais, relacionados a licitações;
  • Experiência com o uso de Sistemas Integrados.
  • Desejável experiência específica, com OPME;
  • Desejável conhecimento de produtos das Unidades de Negócios presentes na empresa.

Informações adicionais

  • Regime de contratação: CLT
  • Escala e Jornada de trabalho: 5X2 - segunda a quinta, de 8h as 18h e sexta, de 8h as 17h (CH: 220h mensais)

- Cesta Natalina, para celebrar o fim de ano com mais sabor

- Parcerias com instituições para descontos

- Massoterapia no trabalho (exclusivo BA)

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.
Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.
About SIMBA Voice Agents by Speechify
SIMBA lets companies deploy natural, human-sounding AI voice agents in 71+ languages with sub-second latency. We're growing fast and need the systems to match — which means building the outbound engine, sales infrastructure, and automation stack that fills pipeline and keeps it moving.
About the Role
We're hiring our first GTM Engineer for SIMBA. You'll build and own the technical systems that power our outbound motion — from lead enrichment and sequencing to CRM architecture and AI-powered personalization at scale.
This is purely an infrastructure and systems role. You'll be the person behind the scenes making sure the right prospects get the right message at the right time, and that the Sales team has the tooling and data to close. If you've built outbound systems from scratch, live inside Clay and Apollo, and measure your work in pipeline influenced — read on.
What You'll Do

  • Build and maintain SIMBA's outbound infrastructure — lead sourcing, enrichment pipelines, scoring models, and sequencing workflows that run at scale
  • Own the GTM tech stack end-to-end: CRM (HubSpot/Salesforce), enrichment (Clay, Apollo, Clearbit), sequencing (Outreach, Instantly), and the glue between them
  • Deploy AI agents for automated prospect research, personalized outreach generation, and follow-up workflows — reducing manual work for the Sales team
  • Instrument the full top-of-funnel: track what's working, cut what isn't, and continuously optimize for meetings booked and pipeline created
  • Build integrations and automations via APIs, webhooks, and tools like Zapier/Make to keep data clean and systems in sync
  • Evaluate and adopt new AI and GTM tooling rapidly — be the team's resident expert on what's emerging and what's worth building on
What We're Looking For
  • Solid experience in GTM engineering, growth engineering, or RevOps role with a heavy technical lean
  • You've personally built outbound systems from scratch — enrichment pipelines, multi-step sequences, lead scoring — not just managed existing ones
  • Deep hands-on experience with the modern GTM stack: Clay, Apollo, HubSpot or Salesforce, Outreach or Instantly, Zapier/Make, Webhooks, REST APIs
  • You think in funnels and measure everything — pipeline influenced, reply rates, meeting conversion, and cost per opportunity are metrics you track obsessively
  • You ship fast, keep things simple, and don't wait for permission
Nice to Have
  • Experience building GTM systems for an AI, voice, or developer-tools product
  • Familiarity with contact center, CX, or telephony buyer personas
  • Background at a B2C company that also runs a B2B or API sales motion
Why Speechify SIMBA
Build a product that genuinely impresses prospects — sub-second latency and 71+ languages speaks for itself. You'll have high ownership with direct input on GTM strategy, work alongside a team that stays embedded with customers, and operate in a fast-moving environment where your systems have outsized impact.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Desenvolvedor Full Stack Sênior em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Descrição da vaga

Você é um Desenvolvedor Full Stack Sênior com sólida experiência em construção de aplicações críticas, APIs seguras, plataformas de dados e sistemas orientados a microsserviços? Tem maturidade técnica para atuar em ambientes regulados, com dados sensíveis, alta exigência de qualidade, auditoria e desempenho? Então esta vaga é para você.

Esta posição possibilita atuação direta em projetos estratégicos de âmbito nacional, com elevado impacto para o Ministério da Saúde, voltados à estruturação, integração e evolução da governancça e infraestruturas de dados para saúde. Você contribuirá para iniciativas estruturantes que subsidiam políticas públicas, vigilância em saúde, pesquisa científica e inovação tecnológica, atuando de forma articulada com equipes multidisciplinares, instituições parceiras e programas nacionais, em um contexto de alta responsabilidade técnica, científica e institucional.

A vaga é exclusivamente PRESENCIAL , na sede do CIDACS localizada no Parque Tecnológico da Bahia – Edifício Tecnocentro, Rua Mundo 121, Trobogy.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Formação e Liderança: Como um profissional sênior, espera-se que esse indivíduo atue como mentor para membros mais jovens da equipe, transmitindo conhecimento e orientação técnica.
  • Apoiar a definição e aplicação de boas práticas de engenharia de software , incluindo padrões de código, revisão por pares e pipelines CI/CD.
  • Atuar de forma transversal em demandas institucionais do CIDACS relacionadas a plataformas digitais e arquitetura de aplicações , além do projeto Genomas Brasil.
  • Atuar na integração entre front-end, back-end, bancos de dados e pipelines de dados científicos , garantindo consistência e confiabilidade.
  • Contribuir para documentação técnica clara e sustentável (APIs, serviços, fluxos e integrações).
  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações web full stack de média e alta complexidade, com foco em robustez, segurança, desempenho e escalabilidade.
  • Desenvolver interfaces web para gestão, visualização e acesso controlado a dados sensíveis , respeitando políticas de governança, LGPD e princípios éticos.
  • Implementar APIs RESTful (e quando aplicável GraphQL), seguindo padrões de versionamento, autenticação, autorização, auditoria e documentação.
  • Implementar testes automatizados (unitários, integração e, quando aplicável, end-to-end).
  • Participar da manutenção e evolução de sistemas existentes, promovendo refatorações, quando necessário.
  • Trabalhar de forma integrada com arquitetos, engenheiros de dados, bioinformatas e equipes de segurança da informação.

Requisitos e qualificações

QUALIFICAÇÕES E REQUISITOS OBRIGATÓRIOS:

FORMAÇÃO

  • Formação superior completa em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Engenharia da Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.

EXPERIÊNCIA

  • Atuação comprovada como Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack Sênior em sistemas de médio ou grande porte.
  • Experiência profissional sólida de 5 anos em desenvolvimento de software.
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento e consumo de APIs RESTful em ambientes de produção.

CONHECIMENTOS TÉCNICOS

  • Domínio de pelo menos uma linguagem de back-end moderna (ex.: Python, Java, Go, Node.js).
  • Experiência com frameworks web (ex.: Django/FastAPI, Spring Boot, Express/NestJS ou equivalentes).
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento front-end moderno (ex.: React, Vue ou Angular).
  • Experiência com containers (Docker) e familiaridade com ambientes Kubernetes.
  • Experiência com versionamento de código (Git) e fluxos colaborativos.
  • Conhecimento sólido em bancos de dados relacionais e/ou NoSQL (ex. PostgreSQL, MongoDB).
  • Conhecimento de práticas de segurança de aplicações, incluindo autenticação, autorização e proteção de APIs.
  • Capacidade de escrever código limpo, testável e bem documentado.

HABILIDADES INTERPESSOAIS

  • Comunicação clara e objetiva, com capacidade de dialogar com equipes multidisciplinares.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma colaborativa em ambientes científicos e institucionais.
  • Perfil proativo, organizado e orientado à resolução de problemas.
  • Responsabilidade técnica e atenção a qualidade, segurança e impacto das soluções desenvolvidas.

DESEJÁVEIS, MAS NÃO OBRIGATÓRIOS:

DIFERENCIAIS:

  • Experiência com CI/CD, automação de deploys e pipelines DevOps.

OUTRAS QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Experiência com observabilidade (logs, métricas, tracing).
  • Experiência em projetos de saúde, genômica, dados científicos ou ambientes regulados.
  • Conhecimento de infraestrutura como código (Terraform, Helm, GitOps).
  • Conhecimento de LGPD e princípios de governança de dados.
  • Vivência em Trusted Research Environments (TREs) ou ambientes com controle rigoroso de acesso e auditoria.
  • Familiaridade com padrões de interoperabilidade em saúde, como HL7/FHIR ou APIs GA4GH.
  • Inglês técnico para leitura de documentação e interação com parceiros internacionais.

Informações adicionais

SOBRE O PROJETO

Embora a vaga esteja vinculada ao projeto Genomas Brasil, a atuação será transversal, contribuindo também para a evolução das plataformas digitais e aplicações institucionais do CIDACS.

Embora a vaga esteja vinculada a determinados projetos, você como Arquiteto de Soluções atuará de forma transversal nas demandas estratégicas do CIDACS relacionadas à arquitetura de dados, plataformas analíticas e evolução da infraestrutura tecnológica, contribuindo para o amadurecimento arquitetural da instituição como um todo e para outros projetos científicos e institucionais de grande relevância.

Os projetos desenvolvidos, em parceria com o MS, são estruturantes, com forte articulação institucional e alinhamento a padrões e frameworks internacionais. Assim, buscamos profissionais com visão sistêmica, profundidade técnica e senso de responsabilidade científica, que desejem deixar um legado concreto na infraestrutura nacional de dados genômicos, atuando de forma ética, segura e alinhada à ciência aberta.

SOBRE O CIDACS

O CIDACS é um centro pioneiro na integração de dados, focado em entender, estudar e avaliar as condições de saúde da população brasileira por meio de Big Data. Nosso trabalho auxilia gestores públicos, pesquisadores e a comunidade, contribuindo para transformar vidas. Se você, assim como nós, é apaixonado por tecnologia e inovação, junte-se ao nosso time. Aqui, você encontrará um ambiente acolhedor, propício para desenvolvimento e inovação, repleto de profissionais de diversas formações acadêmicas unidos por um propósito.

Nosso trabalho apoia pesquisadores, gestores públicos e formuladores de políticas, contribuindo diretamente para a melhoria das condições de saúde da população brasileira. Atuamos em um ambiente científico de excelência, com forte interação entre tecnologia, dados e pesquisa aplicada.

Aqui, você encontrará:

  • Ambiente colaborativo, ético e intelectualmente estimulante
  • Equipes altamente qualificadas e multidisciplinares
  • Infraestrutura de ponta, incluindo HPC, data lake seguro e Trusted Research Environments (TREs)
  • Incentivo à autonomia técnica, inovação e formação contínua
  • Atuação em projetos de relevância nacional e internacional

Se você se motiva por desafios arquiteturais complexos, ciência orientada a impacto e construção de soluções que extrapolam o laboratório e chegam à política pública, este é o lugar certo.

Se você é apaixonado por desenvolvimento de software, automação e desafios complexos, venha fazer parte dessa missão.

Overview

CARREIRAS PARA SORRIR

Na PepsiCo, você descobrirá um lugar onde nossa missão é criar sorrisos em todo o mundo. Com um portfólio de mais de 500 marcas adoradas, incluindo Gatorade,Lay’se Quaker, nosso trabalho toca milhões de pessoas todos os dias.
